info.title: API.SH: Bunnings
info.description: The Bunnings API from API.SH: public Bunnings data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Usage per day and per endpoint
get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Route prefix, e.g. /tiktok/v1

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO time.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor from `next`.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Bunnings' category tree: every category with its code, name, path (use it in /bunnings/v1/category), link and level, down to `depth` levels.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bunnings-categories

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Levels to return, 1-4 (default 3).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products of one Bunnings category with its breadcrumbs and subcategories, and the same fields, filters, sorts and facets as search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bunnings-category

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: A category path such as tools/power-tools/drills (from /bunnings/v1/categories), or a bunnings.com.au/products/... link.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brands, several separated by `|`.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in AUD.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in AUD.

parameters.name: rating_min
parameters.description: Minimum star rating, 1-5.

parameters.name: offer
parameters.description: An offer from the offer facet.

parameters.name: fulfilment
parameters.description: Click & Collect, Delivery or In-Store.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, rating, name_asc, name_desc, newest.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Bunnings product: name, brand, price and price type, payment options, rating and review count, flags (best seller, new, for hire, trade only, age restricted, dangerous good, special order, marketplace), offers and campaign, stock at the default store for in-store pickup (with aisle and bay) and click & collect, delivery, categories, description, specifications, dimensions, weight, warranty, manuals and documents, variants, images and the original record in `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bunnings-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An item number such as 0919290 (the `id` in search results), or a bunnings.com.au product link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Reviews of one Bunnings product: rating, title, text, nickname, location, date, recommended, helpful votes, verified and incentivized badges, the source when syndicated from the brand, photos and replies; plus the average rating, review count and star distribution. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bunnings-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An item number or bunnings.com.au product link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevant (default), newest, oldest, highest, lowest, helpful.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars, 1-5.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-100 (default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Bunnings (Australia) product search with every filter the shop offers: item number, link, name, brand, price (Melbourne metro store), unit, rating and review count, best seller, new arrival, for-hire and age-restricted flags, marketplace seller, offers, fulfilment options, promotion, key selling points, category path, sponsored flag and image. `facets` lists every filter for the query with counts (use the values as filter params). 36 a page; pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bunnings-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brands from the brand facet, several separated by `|` (e.g. Makita|RYOBI).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category value from the category facet (e.g. Hammer Drills--hammer-drill--L4).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in AUD.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in AUD.

parameters.name: rating_min
parameters.description: Minimum star rating, 1-5.

parameters.name: offer
parameters.description: An offer from the offer facet (e.g. Redemption Offer, New Lowest Prices).

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Click & Collect, Delivery, Marketplace or Special Order.

parameters.name: fulfilment
parameters.description: Click & Collect, Delivery or In-Store (at the default store).

parameters.name: colour
parameters.description: A colour from the colour facet (e.g. BLACK).

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height range in mm as min-max (e.g. 0-120).

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width range in mm as min-max.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth range in mm as min-max.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume range as min-max.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Weight range in kg as min-max (e.g. 1-2).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, rating, name_asc, name_desc, newest.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
